annotations.title: Scan files or staged changes for secrets

description: Pre-commit check. Scans files or directories (paths) and/or the lines added in the staged git diff (staged: true) for known secret patterns. Lists only file:line, the secret type and a masked preview (at most the first 4 characters of values of 20+ characters; short values are shown as an ellipsis), never the original value. Provide paths, staged, or both. Heuristic: a clean result is not proof that nothing sensitive is present.

paths.description: Files or directories to scan. Directories are walked recursively (skipping .git, node_modules, build output and symlinks; at most 2000 files).

staged.description: When true, scan only the lines added in `git diff --cached` (the staged changes) in the server working directory.

name: scan_secrets
title: Scan files or staged changes for secrets
